dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (cobc) as indicated by 'Tectonics: cobc' comment; standard COBOL-85 structured with END-IF terminators

purpose.domain_detail: Supplier master file maintenance - merging a sequential supplier file (FORNECE.DAT) with a movement/update file (ATUALIZ.DAT) to produce an updated supplier file (FORNNEW.DAT)
purpose.summary: This program reads two sequential files: a supplier master file (FORNECE) and a movement/update file (ATUALIZ). It merges them to produce a new updated supplier file (FORNNEW), handling include (I), alter (A), and delete (E/other) operations based on a movement code field (SG-MOVIM), with error detection for mismatched codes.

notable_features: Three sequential file merge pattern (master + movement -> new master)
OPEN EXTEND used for output file
AT END clause with sentinel value (MOVE 999 TO CD-FORNM)
File status checking on OPEN operations
verdict.notes: File is encoded in latin-1 (contains accented Portuguese characters in comments). The program is a classic student exercise in sequential file merge/update, authored by Victor Monteiro Arnoni on 12/09/2021. No COPY statements, no CALL statements, no COMP-3 usage. The logic handles include, alter, and delete operations but lacks some robustness (e.g., no explicit delete movement code check, relies on else branch).
